SELECT b.badge_id AS badgeId, b.badge_name AS badgeName, b.badge_category AS badgeCategory, b.description AS description, b.max_level AS maxLevel,
IFNULL(ub.level, 0) AS level, IFNULL(ub.progress, 0) AS progress, IFNULL(ub.equipped, 0) AS equipped, ub.updated_at AS updatedAt,
bl.requirement_type AS requirementType, bl.requirement_value AS requirementValue, bl.title AS title FROM badge b LEFT JOIN user_badge ub ON b.badge_id = ub.badge_id AND ub.user_num = #{userNum} LEFT JOIN badge_level bl ON b.badge_id = bl.badge_id AND bl.level = IFNULL(ub.level + 1, 1) ORDER BY b.badge_category, b.badge_id

SELECT b.badge_id AS badgeId, b.badge_name AS badgeName, b.badge_category AS badgeCategory, b.description AS description, ub.level AS level, ub.equipped AS equipped FROM user_badge ub JOIN badge b ON ub.badge_id = b.badge_id WHERE ub.user_num = #{userNum} AND ub.equipped = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_badge (user_num, badge_id, level, progress, equipped) SELECT #{userNum}, badge_id, 0, 0, 0 FROM badge
mapper.update: UPDATE user_badge SET equipped = CASE WHEN badge_id = #{badgeId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE user_num = #{userNum}
